item.title: Implement cursor pagination in inventory-api
item.brief: Implement GET /items cursor pagination per the initiative contract. Validate limit as an integer from 1 through 100 with default 20; reject invalid limit and malformed/invalid cursor with HTTP 400 JSON {"error":"..."}. Return ordered items and next_cursor (null for last page), preserving existing item representation. Update README with query parameters, response shape, defaults, and errors. Run python3 -m unittest and keep the suite passing. Commit the changes.
